Select all IC50 activity rows in nM for human RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase (CHEMBL4282). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Use the join path molecule_dictionary -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary, with INNER JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Join docs via activities.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id_or_doi. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
